tools.note: Three local tools plus all tools dynamically returned by the clanki MCP server.

mcp.note: One local stdio MCP client to a fixed external JavaScript path.

authority.fact: The model receives all local tools plus the complete MCP list_tools catalogue without an allowlist/filter.
The MCP catalogue includes state-changing Anki operations such as create-deck/create-card, based on source-level workflow instructions, but the server implementation is outside the repository.
The checked-in main() uses a fixed demonstration prompt rather than interactive user input.

policy_expectations.reason: The full local MCP catalogue is exposed without an explicit per-tool restriction; whether this qualifies as explicitly broad surface depends on scanner semantics.

unresolved: Exact MCP tool catalogue and implementation are unavailable because CLANKI_JS points outside the repository.
State-changing authority is source-indicated by tool names/workflow instructions but not implementation-proven.
No untrusted-input attack path is asserted from the checked-in fixed demonstration prompt.
